title: From Leaves to Clusters: Depth-Efficient SAT-Oracle Synthesis Based on the HRSE Model
summary: Quantum oracles are a common building block of many quantum algorithms, where circuit depth is a primary cost that directly affects overall performance. Synthesizing oracles for SAT (CNF) formulas under a limited ancilla budget, however, tends to yield deep circuits, as existing methods underexploit clause-level parallelism. In this work, we present the Clustered Synthesis Tree (CST), a depth-oriented framework whose core idea is to group the individual clause leaves of a hierarchical synthesis tree into clusters, exposing instance-dependent clause-level parallelism under ancilla…
